# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 4 source snapshot

Upstream: https://github.com/XHYN-PH/XHYN-V-reborn/tree/v0.3-preview4
Tag: v0.3-preview4 (release commit prefix df527e0).

This directory is a verbatim copy of selected files from the upstream MIT-licensed modification layer. The upstream LICENSE and PROVENANCE files are preserved.

This is NOT the original GTA V engine or complete Android port source. The original engine, launcher, game assets/data, proprietary native libraries, private signing material and third-party components are not included. The upstream build also requires a separate exact base APK and pinned tools. Native patches are tied to a specific upstream build and are not generic runtime hooks.

No game APK or game data is bundled.
